fields.statement: QA at 8aad96ca3, binary built fresh with make build to a scratch path, run in a hermetic scratch repo (env -i, own HOME). Built a concurrent pair (hid an entry while a second rhiza set wrote op a, restored it): check printed ok with only the concurrent-entries warn. apply --dry-run (add b, set a, link b depends-on a) exit 0 and wrote nothing; apply exit 0, wrote one entry whose after lists both concurrent heads; change show listed both node.create and the link; render+check ok with only the warn. Repeated applies on it work (a no-op one says the writes cancel out); a second concurrent pair in the same change set still lets apply write. A canonical hand-written ops entry dropping an unwritten op (ErrRevision) in another change set: apply --dry-run and apply both exit 1 with 'changeset: illegal revision', log entry count unchanged; the same with concurrent pairs plus that entry in one change set also fails and writes nothing. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(apply-concurrent|apply|check)$' and ./internal/api -run TestApply pass.
